{{Quote|Ren Moru and his crew are waiting to hear your orders. What's it gonna be, boss?|Harlow Ricks|<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />}}
'''Harlow Ricks''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A friend of [[Ren Moru]], he resided at the [[Blaster's Path]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the town of [[Raider's Cove]] and acted as the intermediate between Ren's [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang and their boss, delivering to them daily orders and handing over their spoils in return.<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />
